description: This file defines extension methods for setting up services and configurations within an ASP.NET Core application. Specifically, it includes methods to add application services, configure JWT authentication, and setup Serilog logging.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures core application services, including MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and scoped dependencies.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT authentication with specified issuer, audience, signing key, and validation parameters.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the ASP.NET Core logger factory.
